newsitem.title: GERMANY: TNT completes Germany management changes.
newsitem.headline: TNT completes Germany management changes.

text.p: TNT said it has completed a management shake-up in Germany following its takeover by the Dutch post company Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV.
Michael Schnuabelt, former express manager, is now sales and marketing manager in place of Raimund Stuer, TNT said.
Dirk-Michael Mueller, the previous regional manager, has taken over as operations manager from Wolfgang Albeck, it added.
Stuer, Albeck and corporate accounts manager Werner Nies left the company after the decision of Frank Blochmann, TNT president for central and eastern Europe, to quit the global express carrier.
TNT said the two new managers had already worked for the company in different management positions in Germany.
On January 17, the company said Vinzenz Wagner had been appinted as the new president of TNT Holding Gmbh. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
